ticket.title: Cannot connect to company VPN
ticket.description: Since this morning I keep getting a timeout error when I try to connect to the corporate VPN from home. The client says 'connection failed' after about 30 seconds. Restarting the client and my router did not help.

retrieved.title: VPN failing for Remote/WFH users
retrieved.description: [TCK-64469] Ticket raised because remote users from Remote/WFH cannot establish a VPN connection and get a timeout during negotiation. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The VPN concentrator serving Remote/WFH had exhausted its IP pool; enlarged the pool and cleared stale sessions, restoring VPN access.
